meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: Claude 会先读仓库状态再动手：把你的改动按逻辑拆成一个个提交、改写分支历史，或查清某行代码何时、被谁、为何改动，并附上具体命令与提交哈希作为依据。
howto.when: 当你要求提交改动、整理分支历史（rebase、squash 等）或调查某处 Git 历史时触发；普通代码编辑不会用到它。

say.text: 把当前改动按逻辑拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先看 diff，再逐个提交并报告哈希

say.text: 这行代码是谁最后改的？用 blame 查一下
say.note: 回答里给出提交哈希、作者和行号证据

say.text: 找出引入这个 bug 的第一个提交
say.note: 用 bisect，需要一条能判断好坏的命令

howto.what_en: Claude reads the repo state first, then splits your changes into logical commits, rewrites branch history, or answers when, by whom and why a line changed—citing commits and commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers whenever you ask for a commit, a history rewrite (rebase, squash), or a git-history investigation; ordinary code edits don't use it.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into a few atomic commits
say_en.note: Reads the diff first, then commits each group

say_en.text: Who last changed this line? Check with blame
say_en.note: Answers with commit hash, author and line evidence

say_en.text: Find the first commit that introduced this bug
say_en.note: Uses bisect; needs a pass/fail command
